children: Overview
US Korean BBQ and CPG firm's Q3 revenue fell 3% yr/yr on lower restaurant sales
Company signed letter of intent to sell 47 restaurants for up to $100 mln
CPG revenue reached $4.7 mln in Q3, with expanded distribution to 2,000+ doors
Outlook
Company expects to reach CPG revenue run rate of $40 mln per year by end of 2027
GEN expects positive consolidated net income on a run-rate basis by end of 2027
Company says proceeds from Chubby deal may allow for future buybacks or dividends
Result Drivers
RESTAURANT SALES DECLINE - Co said restaurant revenue fell 12.7% in Q3 due to a 9.2% drop in comparable restaurant sales and fewer locations in operation

CPG BUSINESS GROWTH - Co generated $4.7 mln in CPG revenue in Q3, with expanded distribution to over 2,000 retail doors, including new placements at Bristol Farms, Vallarta Supermarkets, Olé City Market, UCLA Dining and SoFi Stadium
CORPORATE COST REDUCTION - General and administrative expenses fell 15% yr/yr as co began reducing overhead to align with a leaner CPG-focused business
